descripcion_geo: Coastal region of southwestern Asia Minor, with cities such as Pátara and Mira. Stopover scenario for Paul's trip to Rome.

historias.titulo: Paul in Pátara de Licia: path to Jerusalem
historias.descripcion: From Miletus, Paul and his companions arrive at Pátara and change ships to sail towards Phoenicia.

historias.titulo: The change of boat in Mira de Licia
historias.descripcion: On Paul's journey to Rome, Centurion Julius transfers in Mira de Licia to an Alexandrian ship bound for Italy.

historias.titulo: Nicholas of Mira: bishop of Lycia
historias.descripcion: Saint Nicholas, bishop of Mira in Lycia, is the patron saint of children and the historical source of the Santa Claus tradition.

personajes.descripcion: He passed through Lycia on two of his trips: towards Jerusalem and towards Rome.
Responsible for the transfer of Paul to Rome; In Mira he made the decisive transfer.
Bishop of Mira in Lycia; His generosity became a universal legend.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Lycia: relevant region in the NT world.

cristianismo.descripcion: Bishop Nicholas of Mira (Licia) was so generous with the poor that his memory became the legend of Santa Claus.
cristianismo.significado_teologico: Bishop Nicholas of Mira (Licia) was so generous with the poor that his memory became the legend of Santa Claus.
